text:
maria: Heads-up — sudden surge in queue depth for model:gpt-13b-quant across ap-southeast-1 and us-west-2. Dashboards went red ~10m ago.
ajay: Seeing it too. ap-southeast-1 node avg queue: 300 -> 1100 in 12m, us-west-2: 800 -> 1400. Suspect a customer batch job spike.
ops-bot: ALERT: queue_depth_high model=gpt-13b-quant region=ap-southeast-1 value=1112 threshold=500
sam: Any signs of OOMs or GPU panics? GPU busy_pct is ~98% on the hot shards, but nodes not OOMing. Logs show many small requests with long admission wait.
chen: Looks like scheduler backlog, not memory. Current admission config per-shard is 200 r/s. With this traffic pattern we exceed sustained capacity and queue grows.
maria: Proposal (emergency):
1) Tighten admission for non-SLA traffic in affected regions to 50 r/s.
2) Route low-priority requests to model:gpt-6b-quant fallback.
3) Spin up 2 extra workers in us-west-2 if available.
ajay: Good. Quick commands to apply now:
```
# emergency throttle non-sla to 50 r/s
redwoodctl admission set --region ap-southeast-1 --selector 'tier!=SLA' --rate 50 --burst 100
redwoodctl route update --region us-west-2 --from model:gpt-13b-quant --to model:gpt-6b-quant --selector 'priority=low'
```
sam: Also suggest bumping KV prefetch for gpt-13b-quant in us-west-2 to reduce per-request latency while we stabilize.
chen: I'll run a canary after throttle. If queue drops within 5m we keep settings; otherwise we scale and start per-customer throttles for top offenders.
maria: Applied throttles now. ops-bot, post update.
ops-bot: ACTION: admission rules updated at 1768600045 by maria. Current queue_depth ap-southeast-1=420 us-west-2=860
ajay: ap-southeast-1 down to 260 within 3m — throttle worked. us-west-2 still high, starting scale-up: requesting 2 p4d nodes (est ready ~6m).
sam: If scaling doesn't drop queue, we should enforce short-term per-customer quotas for the biggest traffic sources (look at top-10 by rate).
chen: Snapshot metrics (just pulled):
model,gpt-13b-quant,us-west-2,queue=860,gpu_busy=98.3,avg_wait_ms=412
model,gpt-13b-quant,ap-southeast-1,queue=260,gpu_busy=95.6,avg_wait_ms=210
model,gpt-6b-quant,us-west-2,queue=90,gpu_busy=70.2,avg_wait_ms=120
maria: Created INF-3421 for follow-up (root cause & long-term admission policy). Thanks all, keep updates here and tag if you change routes/rates.
